description: Transactional records for water and electricity consumption in M'diq province, Morocco is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley Data. Real-world transactional records were extracted from local utility billing systems in M’diq province, northern Morocco. Data was obtained from monthly tab-separated text files generated by proprietary billing system. Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley Data. Its tags are Electricity, Billing, Water, Energy Consumption, Morocco. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
